units.source_text: 我走过妙心寺的大街寺前可，发现一个以同样快漫步伐走在我前面的学生的身影。

en.t: As I walked past Teramae on the main street of Myoshinji, I noticed the figure of a student ahead of me, walking with the same quick stride.

units.source_text: 他伫立在一爿古老的低房檐的香烟市买香烟时，我看见了他在制帽下的侧脸。

en.t: When he stopped at an old tobacco shop with low eaves to buy cigarettes, I saw his profile beneath his school cap.
